meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要开始熟悉代码库时,Claude 会系统地把每个源文件从头到尾读完(大文件会分页读),从而建立对代码库的整体认识,方便后续开发。
howto.when: 在开始新项目或不熟悉的项目时;或当你说“学习代码库”“读取代码库”等,要求 Claude 先了解代码再干活时触发。

say.text: 先把整个代码库读一遍,再告诉我项目结构。
我刚接手这个项目,请先学习代码库,然后回答我的问题。
通读所有源文件后,总结主要模块和它们的依赖关系。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude reads every source file in full, paging through large files, to build a deep understanding of the codebase for later work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks Claude to 'learn the codebase', 'read it', or 'prime'.

say_en.text: Read the whole codebase first, then tell me the project structure.
say_en.note: Triggers a full read of all source files.

say_en.text: I'm new to this project. Please learn the codebase before answering my questions.
After reading all source files, summarize the main modules and their dependencies.
